## 1. Executive Summary

**Business Problem**: EU after-sales operations handle ~15,000 tickets/month across 5 markets using fragmented tools — Zendesk (DE/FR) and manual email/phone processes (IT/ES/NL) — resulting in 8.3-hour average resolution time, 23% SLA breach rate, and €1.2M/year in lost productivity from agent system-switching.

**Proposed Solution**: UniTicket — a unified cloud-based ticketing platform providing a single-pane-of-glass agent workspace with intelligent routing, integrated parts/warranty lookup, real-time SLA monitoring, and customer self-service. Phase 1 covers DE + FR markets (80% of volume) targeting go-live by March 2027.

**Expected Outcomes**:
1. Resolution time: 8.3h → < 2h (within 6 months of go-live)
2. SLA breach rate: 23% → < 5% (within 12 months)
3. Annual productivity savings: €900K (DE + FR Phase 1)
4. Data entry errors: 8% → < 1%

**Key Constraints**: CapEx €450K budget, March 2027 deadline (Zendesk EOL), must integrate with SAP ECC + Azure AD, GDPR Art. 5/25 + EU Data Act 2025 compliance required.

---

## 2. Business Context & Problem Statement

### 2.1 Current State

The European after-sales operation for Brand A and Brand B supports ~800 authorised dealers and ~1,200 independent repairers across 5 markets, generating ~€3.2B in annual revenue (42% of regional profit). Today's ticket management landscape is fragmented:

- **DE + FR**: Zendesk (different instances, separately configured) with basic SLA tracking
- **IT + ES + NL**: Shared email inboxes — zero structured ticket management, zero SLA enforcement, zero performance analytics

Tier-1 agents create tickets and attempt resolution using a self-built Wiki (47% first-contact resolution). Escalated tickets require Tier-2 agents to manually cross-reference 3 separate systems: Zendesk (ticket history), SAP ECC (parts availability — 3.2 min per VIN lookup), Dealer Portal (warranty status — 1.8 min). Manual data re-entry between systems causes an 8% error rate (~80 incorrect parts shipments/month at €350 avg cost).

### 2.2 Problem / Opportunity

- **Productivity loss**: 120 FTE hours/week wasted on system context-switching → €1.2M/year at €200/hour fully-loaded cost
- **SLA breaches**: 23% of tickets exceed SLA targets, impacting customer trust and NPS (-12 pts vs benchmark)
- **Market inequity**: IT/ES/NL markets have no structured system — invisible queues, no performance data, unequal service quality
- **System EOL risk**: Zendesk DE instance reaches end-of-life June 2027 — the largest market faces losing its ticket system entirely

### 2.3 Why Now?

1. **Zendesk EOL deadline**: DE instance must be migrated by June 2027 — project must start by Q3 2026 to allow 9 months development + 3 months parallel run
2. **Competitive pressure**: Two competitor brands launched unified after-sales platforms in 2025, achieving < 2-hour resolution and 85%+ first-contact resolution
3. **Customer expectation shift**: 78% of Brand A/B customers expect digital self-service (2026 EU CX Survey); 64% would switch brands after 2 poor experiences
4. **Regulatory momentum**: EU Data Act 2025 mandates connected vehicle data sharing — current fragmented systems cannot comply

---

## 3. Project Scope

### 3.1 In Scope

- **Markets**: Germany (DE) + France (FR) — Phase 1
- **User personas**: Tier-2 technical agents, Tier-1 customer service agents, After-Sales Operations Managers, Customers (self-service portal)
- **Capabilities**:
  - Multi-channel ticket intake (phone, email, web form, dealer portal)
  - VIN-based automatic vehicle/customer/warranty data population
  - Unified agent workspace (ticket + customer + vehicle + parts + KB + AI suggestions)
  - Intelligent routing (skill + language + load balancing)
  - Real-time SLA engine with predictive breach alerts
  - SAP ECC parts availability integration (real-time API)
  - Dealer Portal warranty status integration
  - Customer self-service portal (ticket tracking, status push notifications)
  - CSAT post-resolution survey
  - Operational dashboards (SLA compliance, agent performance, ticket analytics)
  - Migration of ~280K historical tickets (Zendesk DE + FR)

### 3.2 Out of Scope (Explicitly Excluded)

- IT/ES/NL markets — deferred to Phase 2 (separate BRD)
- AI-assisted ticket classification and auto-resolution — deferred to Phase 2
- Customer mobile app integration (YiPet) — deferred to Phase 2 (app team dependency)
- Dealer-facing ticket creation interface — dealer portal unchanged in Phase 1
- Integration with Telematics platform (connected vehicle data) — deferred to Phase 2
- Multi-language AI chatbot — deferred to Phase 2

### 3.3 Future Phases

- **Phase 2 (2027 H2)**: IT/ES/NL rollout, Tier-1 self-service portal, AI-assisted classification, YiPet mobile app integration
- **Phase 3 (2028)**: Telematics integration (predictive maintenance → auto-ticket creation), multi-language AI chatbot, advanced analytics (root cause analysis ML)

## 6. Business Rules Summary

| Rule ID | Rule | Priority |
|---------|------|----------|
| BR-001 | All tickets must be automatically linked to a VIN (or customer ID for non-vehicle issues) at creation | Must |
| BR-002 | Critical tickets (safety-related) must be assigned within 30 seconds and first-responded within 15 minutes | Must |
| BR-003 | Ticket routing priority: Skill match > Language match > Current load (least busy first) | Must |
| BR-004 | Agent access to customer PII is limited to their assigned market(s) only (GDPR Art. 25 data protection by design) | Must |
| BR-005 | Parts orders above €500 require manager approval (2-level authorisation) | Should |
| BR-006 | Tickets idle for > 24 hours without agent update are automatically flagged and escalated to team lead | Should |
| BR-007 | CSAT score below 3/5 triggers automatic ticket re-open and manager review | Could |

> Detailed business rules are maintained in the Business Rules register.

## 7. Constraints, Assumptions & Dependencies

### 7.1 Constraints

- **Budget**: CapEx €450K (2026 approved). OpEx €120K/year recurring. Any scope increase requires change request through steering committee.
- **Timeline**: Go-live by 2027-03-01. Hard deadline driven by Zendesk DE end-of-life (2027-06-01) requiring 3-month parallel run period.
- **Technology**: Must integrate with existing SAP ECC (S/4HANA migration planned 2028 — forward API compatibility required). Must run on AWS EU Frankfurt region. Must use corporate SSO (Azure AD).
- **Regulatory**: GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation, Art. 25 data protection by design, Art. 17 right to erasure, Art. 35 DPIA. EU Data Act 2025 connected vehicle data sharing. Block Exemption Regulation (EU) 461/2010 independent repairer access to technical information.

### 7.2 Key Assumptions

- SAP API v2 will be production-ready by 2026-10-01. **If false**: Fallback to daily SAP extract batch-file import — adds 1-day data latency and 3 weeks development effort.
- DE + FR markets will share a single UniTicket instance with market-specific configurations. **If false**: Separate instances add 3 months and €120K to the project (infrastructure + development + testing).
- Existing Zendesk data (~280K tickets) can be fully migrated using Zendesk API export. **If false**: Read-only Zendesk archive retained alongside UniTicket for historical lookups — degrades single-pane-of-glass UX.
- Customer adoption of self-service portal will reach 40% within 6 months. **If false**: Agent ticket volume reduction targets will not be met; incremental agent headcount may be needed.

### 7.3 External Dependencies

| Dependency | Owner | Expected Date | Impact If Delayed | Fallback |
|------------|-------|---------------|--------------------|----------|
| SAP API v2 delivery | Core Platform Team | 2026-10-01 | Cannot integrate parts lookup → Phase 1 reduced to ticket management only | Batch-file import from SAP daily extract |
| Dealer Portal Warranty API | Dealer Systems Team | 2026-09-15 | Warranty status not auto-populated → agents manually check Dealer Portal (same as today) | Manual lookup — no worse than current state |
| Azure AD SSO Integration | IT Infrastructure | 2026-11-01 | UniTicket cannot go live without corporate SSO | Standalone auth during dev/test only — not acceptable for production |
| Customer App Push Notifications | App Team (YiPet) | 2026-12-01 | Customer self-service portal lacks push notifications → email-only | Email notification only — acceptable for Phase 1 |

## 11. Glossary

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| SIT | System Integration Testing — verifying interfaces between UniTicket and SAP, Dealer Portal, SSO |
| UAT | User Acceptance Testing — agents testing in production-like environment with real scenarios |
| Tier-2 Agent | Technical escalation support agent handling complex diagnostic and repair issues |
| VIN | Vehicle Identification Number — 17-character unique vehicle identifier |
| DPIA | Data Protection Impact Assessment — GDPR Art. 35 requirement for high-risk processing |
| Hypercare | 2–4 week period post go-live with enhanced support and daily status calls |
| PDC | Parts Distribution Centre — regional warehouse for aftermarket parts |
| NPS | Net Promoter Score — customer loyalty metric (0–10 scale) |
| CSAT | Customer Satisfaction — post-interaction survey (1–5 scale) |
| MTTR | Mean Time to Resolve — average time from ticket creation to solution delivery |
| PII | Personally Identifiable Information — any data that can identify an individual |
| RAG | Red-Amber-Green — visual status indicator for project health tracking |
